issues.claim: *No gate and no tower in the under-deck strip* (l. 3145-3150) places a barred gate 'along its way ... at generation and in an epoch circuit S5a's pin resolved by law 2 in its order and the trace laid through it (§4.4 S5a *Trace* (2)), a trace laid through no pin (a contraction, a dossier-admitted circuit by the hand operator's path, a stretch of the bent group) bent locally, between its nearest points clear of the strip on either side of the way'. A contraction is laid through S5a's trace step and its pins: §4.11 'contractWall traces and builds the new ring inside the old one through S5a's trace step and S7's operator' (l. 9311); V06 §3.7.4 (2), (4) (V06 l. 1526-1536) its cost field and 'gates where primaries cross it on ground part 0 (S5a, S7; ...)'. *beneath* (l. 3077-3086) puts 'an epoch's circuit, contraction ... and a hand contractWall's (§4.11: S5a's trace step)' among the pulled or cost-field traces whose barred pin 'is resolved by law 2 in its order — (a) moved along its way, the trace laid through it, (b) its way re-routed, (c) F-WALL's raised-way rung', and row W1 (l. 3338) gives an epoch contraction and a hand contractWall S5a's pin resolution. The local re-lay between nearest clear points is law 2 (a)'s treatment of a given shape, while a cost field 'searches only shapes law 1 admits, its own cost choosing among them' (l. 2810-2813). The laws govern (law 2 (a); S5a's pin rule, l. 6600); both treatments keep law 1, §5.3's row and T110-4 check it, and T110-2 (4)'s contraction (l. 19411-19412) asserts no gate place: an example differing from the laws, a minor.
issues.required_change: The model writes, in *No gate and no tower* (l. 3145-3148): "at generation and in an epoch circuit S5a's pin resolved by law 2 in its order and the trace laid through it (§4.4 S5a *Trace* (2)), a trace laid through no pin (a contraction, a dossier-admitted circuit by the hand operator's path, a stretch of the bent group)" → "at generation, in an epoch circuit and in a contraction, an epoch's or a hand `contractWall`'s (§4.11: S5a's trace step), S5a's pin resolved by law 2 in its order and the trace laid through it (§4.4 S5a *Trace* (2)), a trace laid through no pin (a dossier-admitted circuit by the hand operator's path, a stretch of the bent group)".

issues.claim: Law 2 resolves every meeting '(a), then (b), then (c), each tried only where the one before leaves no lawful shape, for every op on every path' (l. 2752-2754), (b) moving a ground way, a plot or an unlocked building by its own law (l. 2815-2821). V07 §3.11's palisade REPLACEMENT — row W14's village-epoch path — gives two steps: 'the run laid again in its new section by §2.7's laws (law 2 (a): its line kept where its new band is lawful, re-traced locally where not, its gates kept — never moved for a meeting (J148): where a kept gate would then stand where law 1 (5) bars one, or with no other lawful shape, the REPLACEMENT waiting, law 2 (c); its worked example row W14)' (V07 l. 2312-2315); W14's event cell names the same pair, '(E: a village epoch; law 2 (a), (c))' (l. 3351), while the same row's hand path, §7.3's S7 operator, meets each raised way 'by §2.7's laws (law 2, in its order; ...)' (l. 11597). Step (b) is not empty here: the local re-trace runs along the under-deck strip's edge (the bent-group sentence's (i), l. 3197-3202), carrying the stone run's band and `palisade.bandM` wall strips over ground beside the strip where VS4's trackers turn along it (V07 §3.5a (3), V07 l. 1591-1596) and S10 lays closes (V07 §3.5a (5), V07 l. 1634-1640) — Tier-3 things (a) does not move and (b) does; repair-r7x-V07's sweep kept the sentence because a kept gate is Tier 1, which holds for the gate, not for the re-trace. Minor: every epoch op runs 'through the same operator a hand convert or edit uses (§7.1), so an epoch's change and a hand change are one code path' (V06 §3.1 (4), V06 l. 968-969), and that operator takes law 2 in its order; law 2 (c) is the step 'failing' (b); so the sentence restates law 2's order with a step unnamed — the class adjudication-r7x closes by its form F3.
issues.required_change: V07 §3.11 (V07 l. 2312-2315): "the run laid again in its new section by §2.7's laws (law 2 (a): its line kept where its new band is lawful, re-traced locally where not, its gates kept — never moved for a meeting (J148): where a kept gate would then stand where law 1 (5) bars one, or with no other lawful shape, the REPLACEMENT waiting, law 2 (c); its worked example row W14)" → "the run laid again in its new section, resolved by §2.7's laws, law 2, in its order — (a) its line kept where its new band is lawful, re-traced locally where not, its gates kept, never moved for a meeting (J148); (b) else the ground ways, plots and unlocked buildings that shape meets moved as law 2 (b) moves them; (c) else, and wherever a kept gate would then stand where law 1 (5) bars one, the REPLACEMENT waiting (`walls.waited`) — its worked example row W14". END at model, row W14's event cell (l. 3351): "(E: a village epoch; law 2 (a), (c))" → "(E: a village epoch; law 2, in its order)".

issues.claim: §7.1's dry-run outcomes, 'the one home of every refusal', refuse a declaration that contradicts a dossier fact or a lock, one an availability gate stops, 'or where the input has no lawful form to bend to — ..., a meeting of a wall-like structure and a raised way that §2.7's laws give no lawful shape (law 2 (c); ...)' (l. 11281-11289); law 2 (c) by hand: 'refused, refuse.raised.meeting' (l. 2825-2826); §7.1 *Raised ways* bends a hand course 'to the nearest course they admit, else refused' (l. 11149-11150). V07 restates the rule without that case: §3.5a (1) 'No village tool refuses a raised stroke that contradicts no dossier fact and no lock (item 101 R2; J-VI.4): the rung gate binds only generation (item 290).' (V07 l. 1577-1578) and ## 4's lead 'no village tool refuses a declaration that contradicts no dossier fact and no lock.' (V07 l. 3026) — while §3.5a (4) refuses a T3 wall stroke with no lawful shape (V07 l. 1624-1625) and §3.17's raised-way row refuses 'a hand stroke' (V07 l. 3001). That row names T-V7-48 for the refusal, but T-V7-48 runs none: its table-edit variant runs F-V-RAISED's ladder alone (V07 l. 3709). The base's creation-prefix sentence restates the rule the same way: 'only one that contradicts a dossier fact or a lock is refused (§7.1)' (l. 5794-5795). Minor: §7.1 is the home and §3.5a (4) states the refusal; a build that never refuses such a stroke has no lawful shape to commit, so §5.3's law-1 row and T110-4 (c)'s village rung, which sends hand ops, catch it.
issues.required_change: V07 §3.5a (1) (V07 l. 1577-1578): "No village tool refuses a raised stroke that contradicts no dossier fact and no lock (item 101 R2; J-VI.4): the rung gate binds only generation (item 290)." → "No village tool refuses a raised stroke for its rung (item 101 R2; J-VI.4): the rung gate binds only generation (item 290); a raised stroke is refused only where §7.1's dry-run outcomes refuse a declaration, a meeting with a wall-like structure that §2.7's laws give no lawful shape among them (law 2 (c); V07 §3.5a (4))." V07 ## 4's lead (V07 l. 3026): "no village tool refuses a declaration that contradicts no dossier fact and no lock." → "no village tool refuses a declaration but where §7.1's dry-run outcomes refuse one (a meeting of a wall-like structure and a raised way that §2.7's laws give no lawful shape among them, law 2 (c))." T-V7-48 (V07 l. 3709): after "F-V-RAISED's ladder — the ring re-laid once round the aqueduct, else the palisade omitted, reported `W_RAISED_MEETING` (V07 §3.13; §2.7's laws, law 2 (c));" insert " and, on that variant, a T3 `wall` palisade stroke across the declared aqueduct refused `refuse.raised.meeting` with the nearest lawful declarations, nothing of either written (§2.7's laws, law 2 (c); V07 §3.5a (4));". END at pipeline, §4.1 *Declarations read ahead* (l. 5794-5795): "only one that contradicts a dossier fact or a lock is refused (§7.1)" → "only one §7.1's dry-run outcomes refuse is refused (§7.1; a meeting of a wall-like structure and a raised way that §2.7's laws give no lawful shape among them, law 2 (c))". (V07's integration note, J-VI.4's line at V07 l. 4123, is the same text for the V07 seat's sweep, R7-01 (2).)

held_notes.note: adjudication-r7x.md's held note 1 persists: for a circuit that cannot hold water access and the occupied-footprint rule, whether the walled stage grows unwalled that epoch or waits whole, and whether the circuit is tried again at the next epoch or only at the next growth, is unstated — wall × water and footprints.

adjudication-r7x.md's held note 2 persists: a plot under a `vault` span at a village rung; and what a raised region does to a run or a raised way standing in it (its base and top, a pier's height, a span's headroom and its vault's ceiling) — raised way × plots, wall × terrain.
